sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any one of them is absent, the whole attempt quietly resolves to nothing.

sketches.mechanism: A value moved into a closure cannot be used afterward — the borrow checker enforces that giving something away means you no longer have it
sketches.resonance: Once you give your heart away, the compiler itself forbids you from using it again.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with no methods (a marker interface) defines identity purely through what something is, not what it does
sketches.resonance: Some things in the world are defined not by their actions but simply by being — a name with no demands.
sketches.draft:
interface Beloved {}

class You implements Beloved {}
